health-topic.meta-desc: A made-up topic for the tests: what a wobbly knee is, and when to see someone about it.
health-topic.title: Wobbly Knee
health-topic.full-summary:
What is a wobbly knee?

A wobbly knee is a made-up condition that the tests use. It isn’t real — nothing here is advice, and it says “so” itself.

What are the signs?

  • A knee that wobbles
  • Trouble on stairs:
    • going up
    • going down

If the knee gives way completely, call 911.

GradeWobble
1a little
2a lot
